Loss report: concourse -> woodpecker
[lost] pipeline/ci display.name (the Woodpecker workflow name is its file name; the display name is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/ci ext.passthrough (Ext of provider concourse (resources) is not written to the Woodpecker file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/ci/job/flaky ext.passthrough (Ext of provider concourse (gets) is not written to the Woodpecker file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/ci/job/flaky/step/flaky-step-1 ext.passthrough (Ext of provider concourse (config, input_mapping, tags) is not written to the Woodpecker file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/ci/trigger/0 ext.passthrough (Ext of provider concourse (resources) is not written to the Woodpecker file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/ci/trigger/1 ext.passthrough (Ext of provider concourse (resources) is not written to the Woodpecker file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/flaky job.allow_failure: failure ignore on every step (later steps still run after a failed step)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/trigger/1 trigger.filter.tags: ref filter refs/tags/<pattern> (the tag name filter is written as a ref filter on the tag event)
